default_authority.principle: The applicable ceiling is determined by the court level at which trial is held. On re-election, the ceiling changes to that applicable to the new court level; time elapsed prior to re-election counts toward the new ceiling.

notes: Re-election OCJ→OSCJ: ceiling becomes 30 months. Re-election OSCJ→OCJ: ceiling becomes 18 months. Re-election followed by mistrial and retrial: ceiling at retrial is unresolved — flag as Tier 5. Michael to confirm ceiling-change logic on review.
